scripts.git:pre-commit: npm run git:lint-staged && npm run git:test-staged
scripts.test: npm run test:lint && npm run test:unit && npm run test:types && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:sast && npm run test:bench && npm run test:dast
scripts.test:sast: npm run test:sast:lockfile && npm run test:sast:semgrep && npm run test:sast:trufflehog && npm run test:sast:gitleaks && npm run test:sast:actionlint && npm run test:sast:zizmor && npm run test:sast:trivy
scripts.test:sast:gitleaks: npm run test:sast:gitleaks:dir && npm run test:sast:gitleaks:git
scripts.rm: npm run rm:macos && npm run rm:node_modules && npm run rm:lock
scripts.update: corepack up && npm run rm && npm install --workspaces
scripts.release:sync: npm version $npm_package_version --workspaces; find ./packages ./websites -name "package.json" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -exec sed -i.bak -E "s#\"@willfarrell-ds/(.*)\": ([^,]*)#\"@willfarrell-ds/\1\": \"$(npm pkg get version | tr -d '\"')\"#g" {} \; && find ./packages ./websites -name "package.json.bak" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" -delete && npm run rm && npm install && npm run lint
scripts.release:staged: npm whoami >/dev/null && npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r '.[] | "\(.packageName)@\(.version) \(.actor) \(.shasum)"'
scripts.release:approve: npm query '.workspace:not([private])' | jq -r '.[].name' | xargs -n1 -I{} npm stage list {} --json | jq -r --arg v "$npm_package_version" '.[] | select(.version == $v) | .id' | xargs -n1 -o npm stage approve
